flavor.phonemic_palette: Akkadian backbone (sh, ', kh, ts, q; vowels a i u; endings -u/-tu/-um; mimation) with Egyptian overlay touches (occasional -aa/-et, Per-/Pa- in toponyms); theophoric stems are second-order morphs of the Punic forms (Tulrishu-, Arganzu-, Urlanzu-, Rialtu-).
flavor.phenotype_notes: Synthesis of Mesopotamian + Egyptian per setting-lore §5.3 (blend the listed features; exclude the inverse).

magic_attitude.notes: Mesopotamian + Egyptian register; deity-morphs in name_bank 'sumset'.

religion_hooks.alignment_lens: Resolved per the culture's chosen alignment (setting-lore §4.2): Lawful venerates the 12 Lawful powers and names the 13 as demons; Chaotic venerates the 13 and names the 12 as tyrant-gods; Neutral venerates this culture's ancestral saints, invoking the great gods only situationally.

flavor_text.one_line: Sumset — wary theocratic of the desert; piety, tradition.
flavor_text.one_paragraph: The Sumset (Mesopotamian + Egyptian) are a assertive theocratic people seeded in desert, jungle, hills. They prize piety, tradition, law, lean toward the religious sphere, and field heavy_infantry, chariots, archers. Outsiders are met as wary; their patrons touch law, death, harvest.
